Affiliate Program Description:

• Brand Introduction: Welcome to Brazilian Flame, where we are driven by the art of perfecting grilling. Our deep-rooted passion for barbecue is born from decades of Brazilian culinary tradition. Our mission is to revolutionize the American barbecue experience by sharing our expertise. Trust us, we know barbecue. 

• Product Description: Brazilian Flame is more than just an exceptional grill. We offer a complete suite of products designed to enhance your grilling experience. Along with our grills that replicate the authentic Brazilian barbecuing process, we also provide a range of high-quality knives and accessories. Our knives, crafted with precision and durability in mind, are perfect for any culinary task. Meanwhile, our grilling accessories, such as baskets and skewers, complement our grills to ensure every barbecue is a breeze. With our products, not only can you savor succulent, flavorful meat, perfectly barbecued on all sides, but you also enjoy a smokeless and easy-to-use experience. With Brazilian Flame, say goodbye to the lonely times by the grill, it's all about "stick and go".

• USP (Unique Selling Point): The unique selling point of Brazilian Flame lies in its authentic replication of the Brazilian barbecuing process, offering an unmatched, flavorful experience right at home. We provide a smokeless and easy-to-use product that allows everyone to enjoy the taste of perfect barbecue, without the usual hassles. Our product's convenience, combined with the unforgettable taste it delivers, distinguishes us from other barbecue options available in the market. With Brazilian Flame, you're not just cooking; you're creating an unforgettable culinary experience inspired by the best Brazilian Steakhouses, turning every meal into a celebration.

• Payment Terms: As an affiliate, your commissions will be paid through Paypal or Venmo, ensuring you receive your earnings as soon as possible, and no later than within 7 days.

• Other Information: At Brazilian Flame, we're committed to ensuring a seamless experience for our customers. That's why we offer Free Delivery and a 30-day risk-free trial on all our products. In addition, our dedicated customer support team is always ready to assist you with any inquiries or concerns. You can reach us at:

Phone: (833) 753-9374

Email: support@brazilianflame.com

We're here to ensure you get the best out of your Brazilian Flame experience.

Join us in our journey and let's bring the Brazilian Flame to every home in America!
